messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Elevated error rate and 95th latency spike detected for model_family=gulliver-8b across region=us-west-2. Autoscaler reports RPM surge above configured thresholds.
jamie_oncall: paging oncall. I'm looking. :rotating_light:
ajamie_oncall: (typo) sorry, jamie_oncall: starting triage — pulling recent p99 logs and routing decisions.
alex_sre: I see a sustained burst from tenant analytics-inc — alpha keys making large parallel streaming requests. RPM ~4.1x baseline for last 6m.
sara_prod: customer impact? any 5xxs or just latency?
alex_sre: primarily tail latency and some client timeouts (~1.7% 502s). No infra OOMs.
maria_support: Maria from support — getting 2 inbound tickets from Analytics-INC complaining about timeouts on embeddings job.
jamie_oncall: ok. immediate mitigation: we can surgically lower per-model RPM for gulliver-8b and limit per-tenant concurrency. I'll apply a temporary quota carveout.
jamie_oncall: applying patch to rate config now:
```json
PATCH /api/v1/ratelimits
{
  "model_family": "gulliver-8b",
  "scope": "tenant:analytics-inc",
  "rpm": 30,
  "concurrency": 4,
  "reason": "emergency - target tenant surge causing p99 latency"
}
```
deploy-bot: Configuration change accepted (change-id: cfg-2026-09-04-001). Rolling enforcement to us-west-2 nodes.
alex_sre: enforcement in progress — nodes reporting new token buckets. Monitoring. :eyes:
jamie_oncall: also toggled streaming buffer backpressure to reduce KV cache churn; disabled function_calling for gulliver-8b for this tenant to reduce RPCs.
sara_prod: will notify the customer thread and let them know we limited throughput to stabilize latency; ask them to retry smaller batches.
maria_support: informing Analytics-INC now. Template: "We’ve temporarily limited requests for the Gulliver model to stabilize traffic; ETA 30-60m."
alex_sre: p95/p99 trending down after 45s. 502s falling back to 0.4%. CPU utilizations on serving hosts dropped ~20%.
jamie_oncall: good. action items: 1) keep per-tenant rpm=30 for next 20m while monitoring, 2) if p99 < 700ms for 10m, start gradual lift in 10rpm increments, 3) if errors reappear revert and escalate.
jamie_oncall: handing to night oncall: @tony_night — briefed, logs & change-id cfg-2026-09-04-001 in play. Please take ownership for next shift.
tony_night: on it. Thanks Jamie — I have dashboard + alert rules. I'll notify if any regression.
sara_prod: any followup needed for product or SLOs? We should flag the incident in the postmortem queue if we keep the throttle >30m.
jamie_oncall: agreed. I'll create an incident stub and tag eng-sre + product for a quick RCA if this persists.
maria_support: customers updated. They appreciate the quick mitigation and asked for ETA. Providing 45m provisional.
alex_sre: note for RCA: look into request patterns — streaming vs batch, and whether new client-side retry backoff caused the surge. Also check cache TTL changes.
jamie_oncall: closing temporary triage thread — moving to incident channel for formal doc if we need a postmortem. filing stub: incident-gulliver-2026-09-04. :white_check_mark:
